mapper.select: SELECT reward_id AS rewardId, reward_name AS rewardName, required_point AS requiredPoint, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, image_url AS imageUrl FROM reward ORDER BY required_point ASC
SELECT reward_id AS rewardId, reward_name AS rewardName, required_point AS requiredPoint, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, image_url AS imageUrl FROM reward WHERE reward_id=#{rewardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reward SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - 1 WHERE reward_id = #{rewardId} AND stock_quantity > 0
